changelog: - **The Focus view and neighbour keys act only on the canvas.** `f` (Focus view) and `[` / `]` (select the previous or next connected node) also worked while you were using the left panel, the timeline or the status bar, so a key pressed there could change the canvas behind it. Now they work only while the canvas has the keyboard: click the canvas — its empty background or a node — first. Right after the app opens, before you click anything, they do nothing.
